title: RegisterRawInputDevices with RIDEV_INPUTSINK not working in 4.7.2 mono .NET
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.7.2.stable.mono.official [ed1daf0bf]
- Not reproducible in: v4.7.1.stable.mono.official [a13da4feb]

### System information

Godot v4.7.2.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9597) - AMD Ryzen 7 3700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 31.92 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

A window that registers itself for raw keyboard input via RegisterRawInputDevices (with RIDEV_INPUTSINK, HID_USAGE_GENERIC_KEYBOARD) stops receiving WM_INPUT messages entirely in 4.7.2, even while the window has OS focus. This worked correctly in 4.7.1 with the exact same project and code.

To rule out interference from my own window procedure subclassing, I added a WH_GETMESSAGE hook via `SetWindowsHookEx`, which checks messages in the thread's message queue *before* they are dispatched to any window procedure.
This hook:
- In 4.7.1: reports hundreds of WM_INPUT messages arriving in the queue, in lockstep with my own WndProc receiving them.
- In 4.7.2: reports **zero** WM_INPUT messages ever arriving in the queue, for the entire session, despite continuous key presses while the window is focused.

I also queried the registration state via GetRegisteredRawInputDevices before and periodically after registration.
Note: this readback reports `flags=0x0, hwndTarget=0` for the keyboard device shortly after registration **in both 4.7.1 and 4.7.2**, identically, yet WM_INPUT kept arriving normally in 4.7.1 despite this readback.
This means the GetRegisteredRawInputDevices readback is not a reliable signal here (it may reflect stale/cached data, or there may be a separate, unrelated quirk in that particular query API) and should not be used to diagnose this issue: the actual regression is only visible through the WH_GETMESSAGE hook / absence of WM_INPUT delivery.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Open the attached MRP (`RawInputRegression_MRP.zip`) in the Godot editor, using 4.7.1 first as a baseline.
2. Run it (F5). Keep the Output panel visible.
3. Click on the running game window to give it focus, then press any key repeatedly.
4. Observe `[RawInputProbe] WM_INPUT received (count=N)` and `[WH_GETMESSAGE hook] WM_INPUT seen in thread queue (count=N)` log lines incrementing together for every key press.
5. Repeat steps 1-4 in 4.7.2.
6. Observe that neither log line ever appears, no matter how many keys are pressed, even though the window is focused throughout.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[RawInputRegression_MRP.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31336104/RawInputRegression_MRP.zip)
